about: A tall crested plant-eating dinosaur that walks on two or four legs; it honks through its hollow crest to warn the herd.
notes: v1 brief for the torch backend (MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 on CUDA). Each prompt asks for several events with pauses in one 8 s file, and the picker cuts the best of them. Slots with loop: true are beds: the picker cuts a seamless stretch.

prompts.text: A large crested dinosaur gives deep resonant honking calls through a hollow crest, like a low foghorn trumpet, three separate calls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large crested dinosaur blares a loud alarmed trumpeting honk, three separate alarms with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large herbivore dinosaur bellows in pain, short hurt honks, four separate cries with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large herbivore dinosaur lets out a long fading mournful dying moan, two separate times with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large herbivore dinosaur snorts and lunges with a heavy grunt, four separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Heavy footsteps of a large two-ton animal walking slowly on earth: deep padded thuds, well spaced. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
